# Third-party components

Application code: MIT, see root LICENSE.

- Electron 44.9.0: MIT, https://github.com/electron/electron . The complete Windows distribution retains LICENSE.electron.txt and LICENSES.chromium.html from the official runtime.
- Koffi 3.3.3: MIT, https://github.com/Koromix/koffi . Its license is reproduced in KOFFI-LICENSE.txt.
- electron-builder 26.15.3: MIT, https://github.com/electron-userland/electron-builder . Build tool only; Windows installer also contains the upstream NSIS runtime.
- Android SDK platform and Build Tools are obtained separately from Google. No SDK, JDK or private signing identity is included in source. Java uses platform APIs; the APK does not contain a copied private classes.dex.
